# Data wrangling

Load data

```{r}
# VI
VI_run_summary <- read.csv('VI_run_summary_4500.csv')
VI_param_recov <- read.csv('VI_param_recovery_4500.csv')
# EM
EM_run_summary <- read.csv('EM_run_summary_4500.csv')
EM_param_recov <- read.csv('EM_param_recovery_4500.csv')
# PSN
PSN_run_summary <- read.csv('PSN_run_summary_4500.csv')
PSN_param_recov <- read.csv('PSN_param_recovery_4500.csv')
# MCMC
MCMC_run_summary <- read.csv('MCMC_run_summary_4500.csv')
MCMC_param_recov <- read.csv('MCMC_param_recovery_4500.csv')

```



Merging the run log and overall parameter recovery data

```{r}
# VI
VI_run_df <- VI_run_summary %>% 
  left_join(VI_param_recov, by = c('benchmark', 'irt', 'sample_size', 'rep')) %>% 
  mutate(method = 'VI')

# EM
EM_run_df <- EM_run_summary %>% 
  left_join(EM_param_recov, by = c('benchmark', 'irt', 'sample_size', 'rep'))%>% 
  mutate(method = 'EM')

# PSN
PSN_run_df <- PSN_run_summary %>% 
  left_join(PSN_param_recov, by = c('benchmark', 'irt', 'sample_size', 'rep'))%>% 
  mutate(method = 'PSN')

# MCMC
MCMC_run_df <- MCMC_run_summary%>% 
  left_join(MCMC_param_recov, by = c('benchmark', 'irt', 'sample_size', 'rep'))%>% 
  mutate(method = 'MCMC')

run_df <- list(VI_run_df, EM_run_df, PSN_run_df, MCMC_run_df) %>%
  bind_rows()

#write.csv(run_df, file = "run_lv_summary.csv")

```

Summary of error messages:

```{r}
#table(run_df$specific_error)

run_df <- run_df %>% mutate(
    failure_category = case_when(
      is.na(specific_error) | specific_error == "" ~ NA_character_,
      grepl("DUE TO TIME LIMIT", specific_error, fixed = TRUE) ~ "Hitting 72-hour time limit",
      grepl("batch_wrapper_exit_137", specific_error, fixed = TRUE) ~ "Out-of-memory",
      grepl("An error occured during compilation", specific_error, fixed = TRUE) ~ "MCMC compilation failure",
      grepl("Expected parameter concentration", specific_error, fixed = TRUE) ~ "Estimation algorithm failure",
      grepl("MH sampler failed", specific_error, fixed = TRUE) |
        grepl("non-finite value supplied by 'nlm'", specific_error, fixed = TRUE) |
        grepl("Lapack routine 'dsyevr'", specific_error, fixed = TRUE) |
        grepl("Inf or NaN values appeared in the gradient", specific_error, fixed = TRUE) ~ "Estimation algorithm failure",
      TRUE ~ "Other failure"
    ),
     warning_category = case_when(
      is.na(specific_warning) | specific_warning == "" ~ NA_character_,
      grepl("CmdStan's precompiled header \\(PCH\\) files may need to be rebuilt\\.", specific_warning) ~ NA_character_,
      grepl("MHRM terminated after 2000 iterations\\.", specific_warning) ~ "EM non-convergence",
      grepl("NaNs produced \\| NA/NaN replaced by maximum positive value", specific_warning) ~ "EM non-convergence",
      grepl("divergence", specific_warning, fixed = TRUE) ~ "Estimation algorithm failure"
  ),
    failure_warning_combined  = case_when(
      !is.na(failure_category) ~ failure_category,
      !is.na(warning_category) ~ warning_category,
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    benchmark = factor(
      benchmark,
      levels = c("truthfulqa", "arc", "winogrande", "gsm8k", "hellaswag", "mmlu")
    ),
    sample_size = factor(sample_size, levels = c(30, 100, 180, 400, 1000)),
    method = factor(method, levels = c("EM", "MCMC", "VI", "PSN")),
    irt = factor(irt, levels = c("1pl", "2pl", "3pl"))
  )

table(run_df$failure_category, run_df$exit_status)
table(run_df$warning_category, run_df$exit_status)
table(run_df$failure_warning_combined, run_df$exit_status)

# merge with the short 100-item benchmark score-total correlation summary
FI_shortform <- read.csv('top100_fi_score_correlations.csv')

FI_shortform %>% mutate(
      benchmark = factor(
      benchmark,
      levels = c("truthfulqa", "arc", "winogrande", "gsm8k", "hellaswag", "mmlu")
    ),
    sample_size = factor(sample_size, levels = c(30, 100, 180, 400, 1000)),
    method = factor(method, levels = c("EM", "MCMC", "VI", "PSN")),
    irt = factor(irt, levels = c("1pl", "2pl", "3pl"))
)->FI_shortform

run_df %>% left_join(FI_shortform, by = c('benchmark', 'irt', 'sample_size', 'rep', 'method'))->run_df
run_df <- run_df %>%
  mutate(
    benchmark = factor(
      benchmark,
      levels = c("truthfulqa", "arc", "winogrande", "gsm8k", "hellaswag", "mmlu"),
      labels = c("TruthfulQA", "ARC-Challenge", "WinoGrande", "GSM8K", "HellaSwag", "MMLU")
    )
  )

write.csv(run_df, file = "run_df.csv")
```

# Main question 

Effect of \(N\), \(J\) on reliable estimation of 1/2/3PL using different estimation methods.

```{r}
summary_by_condition <- run_df %>% group_by(benchmark, irt, sample_size, method) %>% 
  summarise(fail_rate = sum(!is.na(failure_warning_combined))/sum(finished), 
            EM_nonconvergence_rate = sum((failure_warning_combined=='EM non-convergence' | 
                                            failure_warning_combined == 'Estimation algorithm failure'),na.rm = T)/sum(finished),
            Estimation_alg_failure_rate = sum(failure_warning_combined=='Estimation algorithm failure',na.rm = T)/sum(finished),
            Maxtime_rate = sum(failure_warning_combined == 'Hitting 72-hour time limit', na.rm = T)/sum(finished),
            Out_of_mem_rate = sum(failure_warning_combined=='Out-of-memory',na.rm = T)/sum(finished)) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ na_if(.x, NaN)))

summary_by_condition_completed <- run_df_params %>% group_by(benchmark, irt, sample_size, method) %>% 
  summarise(ave_run_time = mean(run_time, na.rm = TRUE),
            cor_b_m = mean(cor_b, na.rm = TRUE),
            cor_b_sd = sd(cor_b, na.rm = TRUE), 
            cor_a_m = mean(cor_a, na.rm = TRUE), 
            cor_a_sd = sd(cor_a, na.rm = TRUE), 
            diff_c_m = mean(diff_c, na.rm = TRUE), 
            diff_c_sd = sd(diff_c, na.rm = TRUE), 
            rho_theta_m = mean(cor_theta_pearson, na.rm = TRUE),
            rho_theta_sd = sd(cor_theta_pearson, na.rm = TRUE),
            tau_theta_m = mean(cor_theta_kendall, na.rm = TRUE),
            tau_theta_sd = sd(cor_theta_kendall, na.rm = TRUE),
            p_diff_m = mean(p_diff_ave, na.rm = TRUE),
            p_diff_sd = sd(p_diff_ave, na.rm = TRUE),
            ave_model_m = mean(p_diff_models, na.rm = TRUE), 
            ave_model_sd = sd(p_diff_models, na.rm = TRUE),
            ave_item_m = mean(p_diff_items, na.rm = TRUE),
            ave_item_sd = sd(p_diff_items, na.rm = TRUE),
            tau_shortform_m = mean(kendall_cor, na.rm = TRUE),
            tau_shortform_sd = sd(kendall_cor, na.rm = TRUE),
            rho_shortform_m = mean(pearson_cor, na.rm = TRUE),
            rho_shortform_sd = sd(pearson_cor, na.rm = TRUE),)%>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ na_if(.x, NaN)))

#summary_by_condition %>% write.csv(file = "run_summary_by_condition.csv")
#summary_by_condition_completed %>% write.csv(file = "run_summary_by_condition_completed.csv")
summary_psn_time <- read.csv('run_summary_by_condition_completed_w_psntime.csv')
summary_psn_time_clean <- summary_psn_time %>%
  mutate(
    benchmark = recode(
      benchmark,
      "truthfulqa" = "TruthfulQA",
      "arc" = "ARC-Challenge",
      "winogrande" = "WinoGrande",
      "gsm8k" = "GSM8K",
      "hellaswag" = "HellaSwag",
      "mmlu" = "MMLU"
    ),
    method = recode(method, "psn" = "PSN", "PSN" = "PSN"),
    irt = tolower(irt),
    sample_size = as.character(sample_size)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    benchmark = factor(benchmark, levels = levels(summary_by_condition_completed$benchmark)),
    irt = factor(irt, levels = levels(summary_by_condition_completed$irt)),
    sample_size = factor(sample_size, levels = levels(summary_by_condition_completed$sample_size)),
    method = factor(method, levels = levels(summary_by_condition_completed$method))
  )
summary_by_condition_completed <- summary_by_condition_completed %>%
  left_join(
    summary_psn_time_clean %>%
      select(benchmark, irt, sample_size, method, ave_run_time_psn = ave_run_time),
    by = c("benchmark", "irt", "sample_size", "method")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    ave_run_time = coalesce(ave_run_time, ave_run_time_psn)
  ) %>%
  select(-ave_run_time_psn)
```

  
## 1. Estimation failure, including rate and types.


Overall failure rate:

```{r}
run_df %>% ungroup() %>% 
  filter(is.na(failure_warning_combined) | failure_warning_combined != 'Hitting 72-hour time limit')%>%
  group_by(method) %>% 
  summarize(overall_fail_rate = sum(!is.na(failure_warning_combined))/sum(finished==TRUE))

run_df %>% ungroup() %>% 
  group_by(method,irt) %>% 
  summarize(overall_fail_rate = sum(!is.na(failure_warning_combined))/sum(finished==TRUE))

# mcmc oot for other conditions 
run_df %>% ungroup() %>%
  filter(method == 'MCMC', benchmark%in% c('HellaSwag','MMLU')) %>%
  filter(!((benchmark == 'MMLU' & sample_size ==1000) | (benchmark =='MMLU' & sample_size == 400 & irt =='3pl') |
             (benchmark == 'HellaSwag' & sample_size ==1000 & irt =='3pl'))) %>%
  summarize(completed = sum(finished), 
            oot = sum(failure_warning_combined=='Hitting 72-hour time limit', na.rm = T))
  

```




```{r}

ggplot(
  summary_by_condition,
  aes(x = benchmark, y = fail_rate, group = sample_size, color = sample_size)
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 1.8) +
  facet_grid(irt ~ method) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  scale_color_grey(start = 0.1, end = 0.8, name = "Sample size") +
  labs(
    x = "Benchmark",
    y = "Failure rate"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95"),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  ) 
```

Note: 

- For VI all errors are "Estimation algorithm failure"
- For MCMC all errors are "MCMC compilation failure" (related to CmdStan compilation), "Estimation algorithm failure" (divergence), or hitting 72-hour timewall.


EM run status decomposition:

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

bar_df <- run_df %>%
  filter(method == "EM", finished == TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    run_status = case_when(
      is.na(failure_warning_combined) | failure_warning_combined == "" ~ "Successful",
      failure_warning_combined == "EM non-convergence" ~ "Non-convergence",
      TRUE ~ failure_warning_combined
    )
  ) %>%
  count(benchmark, irt, sample_size, run_status)

status_colors <- c(
  "Successful" = "#2CA02C",
  "Non-convergence" = "#FF7F0E",
  "Out-of-memory" = "#D62728",
  "Estimation algorithm failure" = "#9467BD"
)

bar_df <- run_df %>%
  filter(method == "EM", finished == TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    irt = factor(irt, levels = c("1pl", "2pl", "3pl"), labels = c("1PL", "2PL", "3PL")),
    run_status = case_when(
      is.na(failure_warning_combined) | failure_warning_combined == "" ~ "Successful",
      failure_warning_combined == "EM non-convergence" ~ "Non-convergence",
      TRUE ~ failure_warning_combined
    )
  ) %>%
  count(benchmark, irt, sample_size, run_status)


ggplot(bar_df, aes(x = sample_size, y = n, fill = run_status)) +
  geom_col(position = "fill", color = "white") +
  facet_grid(irt ~ benchmark, switch = "x") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format()) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = status_colors) +
  labs(
    x = "Sample size",
    y = "Percent of finished runs",
    fill = ""
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    strip.placement = "outside",
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text.x.bottom = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    strip.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )->p
p

ggsave(filename = 'EM_run_summary.svg',plot = p,height = 4.5)
```

```{r}

theta_skew <- read_csv("theta_skewness_by_benchmark_irt.csv")

plot_df <- summary_by_condition_completed %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    benchmark_raw = case_when(
      benchmark == "TruthfulQA" ~ "truthfulqa",
      benchmark == "ARC-Challenge" ~ "arc",
      benchmark == "WinoGrande" ~ "winogrande",
      benchmark == "GSM8K" ~ "gsm8k",
      benchmark == "HellaSwag" ~ "hellaswag",
      benchmark == "MMLU" ~ "mmlu"
    )
  ) %>%
  left_join(theta_skew, by = c("benchmark_raw" = "benchmark", "irt")) %>%
  mutate(
    method = factor(method, levels = c("EM", "MCMC", "VI", "PSN")),
    sample_size = factor(sample_size, levels = c(30, 100, 180, 400, 1000)),
    alpha_level = case_when(
      sample_size == 30 ~ 1.00,
      sample_size == 100 ~ 0.85,
      sample_size == 180 ~ 0.70,
      sample_size == 400 ~ 0.55,
      sample_size == 1000 ~ 0.40
    )
  )

condition_order <- plot_df %>%
  distinct(benchmark, irt, theta_skewness) %>%
  arrange(theta_skewness) %>%
  mutate(condition = paste0(benchmark, "\n", toupper(irt))) %>%
  pull(condition)

plot_df %>%
  mutate(
    condition = factor(
      paste0(benchmark, "\n", toupper(irt)),
      levels = condition_order
    )

  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = condition,
      y = cor_b_m,
      color = method,
      alpha = alpha_level

    "PSN" = "#D62728"
  )) +
  labs(

    y = "Correlation: true vs estimated b",

  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```

```{r}
  arrange(method, irt, benchmark, sample_size_plot)

  )
```

### C. Response-probability recovery

- Mean absolute deviation between true and estimated probability of correct response:

$$\sum_{i = 1}^N\sum_{j=1}^J |P(Y_{ij} = 1 \mid \theta_i, \boldsymbol\zeta_j) - P(Y_{ij} = 1 \mid \hat\theta_i, \hat{\boldsymbol\zeta_j})|.$$

```{r}
ggplot(
  summary_by_condition_completed,
  aes(x = benchmark, y = p_diff_m, group = sample_size, color = sample_size, fill = sample_size)
) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(
      ymin = pmax(p_diff_m - p_diff_sd, 0),
      ymax = p_diff_m + p_diff_sd
    ),
    alpha = 0.15,
    linewidth = 0,
    color = NA
  ) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 1.8) +
  facet_grid(irt ~ method) +
  scale_color_grey(start = 0.1, end = 0.8, name = "Sample size") +
  scale_fill_grey(start = 0.1, end = 0.8, name = "Sample size") +
  labs(
    x = "Benchmark",
    y = "Absolute error in predicted P(correct)"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95"),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```

## A few sub-questions

1. What is a minimum sample size?

2. Do larger benchmarks require larger sample sizes?

3. Are there item or model characteristics that tend to result in consistently worse recovery of correct response probability at the item (or model) level?

4. Comparison of newer estimators, VI and neural, to EM/MCMC. Are they equally reliable?

5. For EM replications that did not reach tolerance, can we trust the estimates?

6. How much advantage does the IRT trait score have over the total average?

7. Model capability distribution: Does this affect ease of estimation or capability scoring?

## 5.2 Capability scoring

main text a version of this


```{r}

theta_skew <- read_csv("theta_skewness_by_benchmark_irt.csv")

plot_df <- summary_by_condition_completed %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    benchmark_raw = case_when(
      benchmark == "TruthfulQA" ~ "truthfulqa",
      benchmark == "ARC-Challenge" ~ "arc",
      benchmark == "WinoGrande" ~ "winogrande",
      benchmark == "GSM8K" ~ "gsm8k",
      benchmark == "HellaSwag" ~ "hellaswag",
      benchmark == "MMLU" ~ "mmlu"
    )
  ) %>%
  left_join(theta_skew, by = c("benchmark_raw" = "benchmark", "irt")) %>%
  mutate(
    method = factor(method, levels = c("EM", "MCMC", "VI", "PSN")),
    sample_size = factor(sample_size, levels = c(30, 100, 180, 400, 1000)),
    alpha_level = case_when(
      sample_size == 30 ~ 1.00,
      sample_size == 100 ~ 0.85,
      sample_size == 180 ~ 0.70,
      sample_size == 400 ~ 0.55,
      sample_size == 1000 ~ 0.40
    )
  )

condition_order <- plot_df %>%
  distinct(benchmark, irt, theta_skewness) %>%
  arrange(theta_skewness) %>%
  mutate(condition = paste0(benchmark, "\n", toupper(irt))) %>%
  pull(condition)

plot_df %>%
  mutate(
    condition = factor(
      paste0(benchmark, "\n", toupper(irt)),
      levels = condition_order
    )
  ) %>%
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = condition,
      y = tau_theta_m,
      color = method,
      alpha = alpha_level
    )
  ) +
  geom_point(
    position = position_jitter(width = 0.12, height = 0),
    size = 2.2
  ) +
  scale_alpha_identity() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "EM" = "#1F77B4",
    "MCMC" = "#FF7F0E",
    "VI" = "#2CA02C",
    "PSN" = "#D62728"
  )) +
  labs(
    x = "Benchmark and IRT model (ordered by true theta skewness)",
    y = "Kendall's tau: true vs estimated capability",
    color = "Method"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  )->p
p
ggsave("tau_by_skewness_5.2.svg", plot = p, width = 7, height = 4)

write.csv(plot_df, file = 'plotdf_tau_by_skewness.csv')


```

```{r, fig.height=5.5}
library(tidyverse)

random_df <- read_csv("shorttest_cor_random.csv")

plot_df_base <- summary_by_condition_completed %>%
  filter(irt == "2pl") %>%
  mutate(
    method = factor(method, levels = c("EM", "MCMC", "VI", "PSN")),
    sample_size_plot = factor(sample_size, levels = c(1000, 400, 180, 100, 30))
  ) %>%
  arrange(method, benchmark, sample_size_plot)

plot_df <- bind_rows(
  plot_df_base %>%
    transmute(
      method,
      benchmark,
      sample_size,
      sample_size_plot,
      metric = "b correlation",
      value = cor_b_m,
      sd = cor_b_sd
    ),
  plot_df_base %>%
    transmute(
      method,
      benchmark,
      sample_size,
      sample_size_plot,
      metric = "a correlation",
      value = cor_a_m,
      sd = cor_a_sd
    ),
  plot_df_base %>%
    transmute(
      method,
      benchmark,
      sample_size,
      sample_size_plot,
      metric = "Item mean error",
      value = ave_item_m,
      sd = ave_item_sd
    ),
  plot_df_base %>%
    transmute(
      method,
      benchmark,
      sample_size,
      sample_size_plot,
      metric = "Shortform Kendall",
      value = tau_shortform_m,
      sd = tau_shortform_sd
    )
) %>%
  mutate(
    metric = factor(
      metric,
      levels = c("b correlation", "a correlation", "Item mean error", "Shortform Kendall")
    )
  )

baseline_df <- random_df %>%
  filter(irt == "2pl") %>%
  transmute(
    benchmark = case_when(
      benchmark == "truthfulqa" ~ "TruthfulQA",
      benchmark == "arc" ~ "ARC-Challenge",
      benchmark == "winogrande" ~ "WinoGrande",
      benchmark == "gsm8k" ~ "GSM8K",
      benchmark == "hellaswag" ~ "HellaSwag",
      benchmark == "mmlu" ~ "MMLU"
    ),
    value = tau_rand_m
  ) %>%
  crossing(method = c("EM", "MCMC", "VI", "PSN")) %>%
  mutate(
    method = factor(method, levels = c("EM", "MCMC", "VI", "PSN")),
    metric = factor(
      "Shortform Kendall",
      levels = c("b correlation", "a correlation", "Item mean error", "Shortform Kendall")
    ),
    benchmark = factor(
      benchmark,
      levels = unique(as.character(plot_df$benchmark))
    )
  )

ggplot(
  plot_df,
  aes(
    x = benchmark,
    y = value,
    group = sample_size_plot,
    color = sample_size_plot,
    fill = sample_size_plot
  )
) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(
      ymin = case_when(
        metric %in% c("b correlation", "a correlation", "Shortform Kendall") ~ pmax(value - sd, -1),
        metric == "Item mean error" ~ pmax(value - sd, 0)
      ),
      ymax = case_when(
        metric %in% c("b correlation", "a correlation", "Shortform Kendall") ~ pmin(value + sd, 1),
        metric == "Item mean error" ~ value + sd
      )
    ),
    alpha = 0.15,
    linewidth = 0,
    color = NA
  ) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 1.8) +
  geom_line(
    data = baseline_df,
    aes(x = benchmark, y = value, group = 1),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "black",
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = baseline_df,
    aes(x = benchmark, y = value),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "black",
    size = 1.6
  ) +
  facet_grid(metric ~ method, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_grey(
    start = 0.8, end = 0.1,
    breaks = c(30, 100, 180, 400, 1000),
    name = "Sample size"
  ) +
  scale_fill_grey(
    start = 0.8, end = 0.1,
    breaks = c(30, 100, 180, 400, 1000),
    name = "Sample size"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Benchmark",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95"),
    legend.position = "right"
  ) ->p

ggsave("res_2pl_5.3_5.4.svg", plot = p, width = 7, height = 5.5)
```

```{r}
    aes(
      ymin = case_when(
        metric %in% c("b correlation", "a correlation") ~ pmax(value - sd, -1),
        metric %in% c("c RMSE", "Item mean error") ~ pmax(value - sd, 0)
      ),
      ymax = case_when(
        metric %in% c("b correlation", "a correlation") ~ pmin(value + sd, 1),
        metric %in% c("c RMSE", "Item mean error") ~ value + sd
      )
    ),
    alpha = 0.15,
    linewidth = 0,
    color = NA
  ) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 1.8) +
  facet_grid(metric ~ method, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_grey(
    start = 0.8, end = 0.1,
    breaks = c(30, 100, 180, 400, 1000),
    name = "Sample size"
  ) +
  scale_fill_grey(
    start = 0.8, end = 0.1,
    breaks = c(30, 100, 180, 400, 1000),
    name = "Sample size"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Benchmark",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95"),
    legend.position = "right"
  ) -> p3

ggsave('3pl_item_recov.svg', plot = p3,height = 6)

```
